documents.notes: Official Amiri Press text page locator: https://www.alamiria.com/Sec/TashTxt?id=vPdoWGGYwoE%3D. Government-hosted PDF copies of Official Gazette issue 18 (تابع), dated 3 May 2025, are also publicly accessible at the Egyptian State Information Service (https://sis.gov.eg/media/760267/القانون-رقم-14-لسنة-2025-بإصدار-قانون-العمل.pdf) and the Egyptian Tax Authority (https://portal.eta.gov.eg/sites/default/files/2026-03/law.no_.14.of_.2025.pdf). Keep discovery-only: the candidate JSONL has not been fully compared article-by-article with the Gazette; confirm source authenticity, effective dates, amendments/corrigenda, and source-specific collection/commercial-reuse terms before any ingestion or retrieval. Public accessibility does not establish reuse permission. Visual spot-checks against the government-hosted Gazette scan identified transcription differences in the supplied candidate rows: Article 103 (candidate «أراء»; scan «آراء»), Article 124 (candidate «تزاد»; scan «تزداد»), Article 134 (candidate «ينجزها»; scan «ينفذها»), and Article 141 (candidate «تزاد»; scan «تزداد»). This is a partial manual spot-check, not a complete article-by-article comparison or lawyer review; keep discovery_only. The PDF machine-extracted text also contains OCR errors in these same pages (for example, Article 103's «كل ستة أشهر» and Article 82's «المصنعية» are misread in extracted text), so discrepancies must be adjudicated against the page image, not OCR text alone.
